about.headline: Merging *healthcare* with technology.
about.intro: I'm a Flutter developer with a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka. That mix shapes how I work: I understand the problems behind health-tech products, and I care about getting the details right.
bio: I build cross-platform mobile and web apps with Flutter and Dart, backed by Firebase, Supabase and REST APIs. I've delivered 8+ apps across healthcare, education and e-commerce, with releases on both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.

My work covers the full lifecycle: turning Figma designs into polished, accessible interfaces, structuring code with clean architecture and Riverpod, BLoC, GetX or Provider, and taking apps through store review and release.
I wrote my first Flutter app in 2021 while studying pharmacy. Today I focus on products where reliability matters: telemedicine, medical education and the internal tools teams depend on every day.

experience.summary: Building the patient-facing app for an AI-integrated medical consultation platform on Android and iOS.
highlights: Designed and built responsive, patient-facing UI in Flutter; the app has 100+ downloads on Google Play and active users on Android and iOS.
Integrated REST APIs and Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Messaging) for real-time sync, secure accounts and push notifications.
Introduced clean architecture with Riverpod, cutting code complexity by about 30% across 15+ screens.
Kept rendering at a steady 60fps on mid-range devices with lazy loading, leaner rebuilds and image caching.
Own releases end to end through Google Play Console and App Store Connect.

experience.summary: Architected and built Bomach OS, the company's internal operating system, used by 50+ employees across departments.
highlights: Built a full-stack internal operating system in Flutter with integrated front-end and back-end modules for 50+ employees.
Designed a modular Riverpod architecture with clean separation of data, domain and presentation layers.
Delivered 5+ cross-functional features including task management, reporting dashboards and internal communication tools.
Worked with stakeholders on requirements, technical specs and prototype iterations in an Agile process.

experience.summary: Built cross-platform tutorial apps with structured courses, video lessons and interactive assessments.
highlights: Shipped Flutter tutorial apps with structured courses, embedded video content and interactive assessments.
Integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore for content management, secure sign-up and progress tracking.
Cut app load time by 40% with optimized assets, lazy-loaded course modules and Provider-based state management.

experience.summary: Building Quizzy, a real-time competitive quiz platform with multiplayer games and live leaderboards.
highlights: Developed a competitive quiz app with Flutter, Firebase and Riverpod supporting real-time multiplayer games for 100+ users.
Implemented live leaderboards with Firestore listeners that handle concurrent updates without conflicts.
Built engaging animations and transitions that improved engagement and session length.
Tested and debugged across 10+ Android and iOS device configurations.
